title: WOMACK MILLING CO. — business profile
text:
WOMACK MILLING CO.

Some seven or eight years ago, a number of our citizens formed a stock company and built a 50bbl. flour mill and equipped it with the most modern machinery. The mill was started and no one ever ate better pancakes and hot biscuit than this flour made. The capital being limited, there was not enough surplus money to supply the grain necessary for the mill to prosper, hence it was sold to the Womack Milling Co., who immediately erected a steel elevator and increased the capacity to 100bbls. With Jno. Parker manager, and T. J. Liggett miller, it has kept up its reputation for fine flour and has made money for the company. Savoy is proud of her mill and many of her citizens would not buy a sack of flour made any whe[re] els[e]
notes: Right margin clipped on final two lines; last words reconstructed as 'anywhere else'. Early-era business profile.
